quests.paragraphTopic: Stated facts versus conclusions in a transit advisory

pairs.key: [L150-Q3-0] The Blue Line will follow a different route this weekend.
pairs.value: This is directly stated in the passage.

pairs.key: [L150-Q3-1] The Red Line will run a full, normal schedule overnight.
pairs.value: This contradicts the passage, since Red Line service is suspended between 10pm and 5am.

pairs.key: [L150-Q3-2] Full service is expected to resume by the start of the work week.
pairs.value: This is a reasonable conclusion, based on the passage stating repairs aim for full service by Monday morning.

pairs.key: [L150-Q3-3] No routes will see reduced weekday service during the holidays.
pairs.value: This contradicts the passage, which states some routes will be curtailed.

pairs.key: [L150-Q3-4] Commuter complaints played a role in speeding up the repair timeline.
pairs.value: This is directly stated in the passage.

quests.hint: Decide whether each statement is stated directly, a fair conclusion, or contradicted by the passage.
quests.explanation: The first and fifth statements are stated directly. The second contradicts the passage, since the Red Line is suspended overnight. The third is a fair conclusion from repairs aiming for Monday morning. The fourth contradicts the passage, since some routes will be curtailed.
